argv:
Apply the approved Public interface declaration to the architecture working copy, and
any change it makes to a named document to that document's working copy. Do not edit any
other file, including the Registry, product, tests or step definitions. Read each working
copy and replace the exact text the fix provides.

Service: greeter
Approved fix:
The System Architect's answers settle the Public interface of service `greeter`: it is offered across the process boundary as a command-line program (`kind: cli`), declared by the existing OpenCLI-like document `docs/greeter-cli.yaml`, whose coverage the Architect confirmed Complete — it already declares every command (`greet`), flag (`loud`), argument (`person`), file (`greeting-config`), log record (`greeted`) and outgoing call (`notify`) that greeter offers. `ui_elements` is Not applicable for kind `cli`. Therefore change only the architecture document's working copy; make no edit to `docs/greeter-cli.yaml`, no edit to `docs/scenarios.yaml`, and no edit to `docs/product/product.yaml`.

Apply exactly one edit, to `docs/architecture/architecture.yaml`:

old_string:
```yaml
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
```

new_string:
```yaml
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
    public_interface:
      kind: cli
      document: docs/greeter-cli.yaml
```

This adds `public_interface` to the `greeter` entry in `architecture.services` and changes nothing else: `name`, `path` and `language` keep their existing values and order, no other service or top-level key is touched, and `elements` is omitted because it applies only to kind `ui`. The document path is given relative to the Host project root and names an existing document.
